title: Initializing SOL price makes trading unfair
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `initialize_global_state` instruction, the SOL price is initialized at 200 USD/SOL.   ```rust pub fn initialize_global_state_ix(     ctx: Context<InitializeGlobalState>,     start_time: i64,     end_time: i64,     tokens_for_sale: u64, ) -> Result<()> {     ...     oracle_account.mint = constants::DEPOSIT_MINT3;     oracle_account.price = 200_00000;     Ok(()) } ``` However, the actual SOL price may differ significantly.
